BiblicalUsage: Oren was a descendant of Judah, named once among the sons of Jerahmeel in the genealogy of the tribe. He was a son of Jerahmeel, of the tribe of Judah, in the days before the kingdom.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the one mention of Oren is enough: God recorded the sons of Jerahmeel by name, and no branch of the family was left out.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
